about: FrameUp release notes, newest first. One file feeds the What's new panel (app-shell.js) and the What's new tour (tours/updates.js). Add entries with: node scripts/add-release-note.mjs. Item fields: title, text, page (file, optional), route (hash, optional), target (CSS selector, optional). templates: [workspace, dropdown value] pairs tagged New for 30 days. commit: HEAD when the note was written (the CLI reads commits after it).

entries.title: Merch Designs: hoodies, posters, stickers, mugs and Your merch

items.title: More products
items.text: Put a design on a tee, hoodie, poster, sticker or mug. Each one has its own print area, ES logo spot, suggested price and print check.

items.title: Shop collections
items.text: Add a product to Fourthwall collections when you set it up, or later from its panel. Make a new collection on the spot.

items.title: Your merch
items.text: See every product FrameUp made, with its status, link, mockup, and units and revenue for the last 30 days. Archive needs the product name typed in.

entries.title: Merch Designs: ES fan merch on Fourthwall

items.title: From a line to a tee
items.text: Paste a line, quote or story link, or pick a trend, choose a collection, and get tee designs in ES stacked pills. Edit the pills, colours and order on the card.

items.title: Set up and check rights
items.text: Pick the tee, colours, where the ES logo goes and the price, see what you earn per sale, and tick the rights check before pushing.

items.title: Created hidden on Fourthwall
items.text: Products go to Fourthwall hidden. Check the mockups, then Publish. Admins (and named people) can push; everyone can design.

entries.title: Reels Studio: the ES video team's design system

items.title: Every reel in the ES system
items.text: The ES video team's reels design system (from Vinay) is now built into Reels Studio and is the default style: ES paper, boxed pills, counting numbers, dots and bars, the blue-then-ink slab wipe on every cut, one-line captions and the ES end card with the source line.

items.title: Bring your own script
items.text: Pick Script, paste your words and Reels Studio splits them into scenes with a block each. Your script is never rewritten. Without a voiceover, scenes are timed at 2.6 words a second and marked as estimates.

items.title: Checks and guidelines
items.text: Quality checks now include the system's checklist (safe frame, signal colours, copy length, numbers as spoken, end card and source, frame one, banned items) and say Safe frame with a tick when every word is inside. Open ES video guidelines for the rules in plain English, and export a 4:5 feed version too.

entries.title: Newsletter exports on the Dashboard

items.title: Dashboard
items.text: A new Newsletter tab shows every newsletter export: how many this week and over 7, 30 and 90 days, the most exported asset and the most active person, a chart over time, and breakdowns by asset, person and newsletter. The list of recent exports has previews, filters and a search.

items.title: Newsletter
items.text: Newsletter exports now record which asset and which newsletter they were made for, so the Dashboard can group them. The exported images don't change.

entries.title: Clearer export chart

items.title: Dashboard
items.text: The Exports over time chart shows weekly totals for 90 days instead of a jagged daily line, and its dots stay round and inside the card.

entries.title: Usage: everything taken from FrameUp

items.title: What gets counted
items.text: FrameUp now counts every download, copy and shared link, not only exports: ES photos, caption files, copied headlines and HTML, image links, Video Ads and Reels files, and designs opened from Generate, Trends or the Gallery. It saves what was taken and from which tool, never the image itself.

items.title: Dashboard for admins
items.text: A new Usage tab shows it all by type, tool and person, with a daily chart and the latest activity. The dashboard tabs are shorter and grouped.

entries.title: Better Creative designs

items.title: Generate
items.text: Photos now frame the player properly: faces stay in the picture in tall and zoomed layouts, and a swapped photo is framed on its own player.

items.title: Generate
items.text: Pills match the editor: every pill (headlines, kickers, labels, name tags) is Acumin Black in your team's brand-kit colours, straight and solid.

items.title: Generate
items.text: A new mix every time: Generate remembers the looks you were just shown and picks different layouts and colours on the next run.

entries.title: Archive Page FI for newsletters

items.title: Newsletter
items.text: New Archive Page FI asset at 834 x 555: your photo with a dark fade along the bottom and a Quick Read tag you can rename.

entries.title: Music for Video Ads

items.title: Video Ads
items.text: Seven licensed music tracks in the Sound step (calm, lo-fi, chill and hip hop), cleared for organic posts and paid ads.

entries.title: Generate: the right player in every photo

items.title: The right player, checked
items.text: Before a photo is used for a named player, Generate checks the caption, the team, the jersey number and who else is in the frame. A teammate, an opponent, a reporter or a player with the same name is never shown as them.

items.title: A different photo on every design
items.text: Each design in a set gets its own photo whenever ES has more than one of that player.

items.title: League stories
items.text: For a league or company story with no named player, photos must show people tied to it. If none check out, the design uses the logo or type instead.

entries.title: Generate: designs built like the ES board

items.title: Stats posts like ours
items.text: One big number under the ES logo, the player cut out over it, a white label box and the team's colours behind.

items.title: Covers with real highlight boxes
items.text: Headlines sit in tight team-colour boxes, one idea per line, over a full photo.

items.title: Quotes and bar graphs
items.text: Quotes set in white boxes over the speaker, and comparisons drawn as the board's bar graph.

items.title: Headlines keep the point
items.text: A shortened headline never drops the part of the story that matters, and design names never read like a team.

items.title: A stronger art director
items.text: A better AI model plans each set and checks it against real ES posts. A run costs about $0.10 to $0.25, shown when it finishes.

entries.title: Generate: better designs, fixed before you see them

items.title: You get the number of designs you pick
items.text: Ask for 1 to 8 designs and you get exactly that many, even when the story has no stats.

items.title: Small fixes happen while designing
items.text: A murky or off-topic photo, a dropped colon or a missing photo of the person named is fixed before the design reaches you. The director only suggests new ideas now.

items.title: Real photos, no sport tags
items.text: When a player or coach is named, every design shows them, never a faded picture box. Designs no longer carry MLB, NFL or GOLF tags.

entries.title: Generate: clearer ideas, a time estimate and better briefs

items.title: Ideas you can read in full
items.text: The assistant's ideas show their whole text, and small fixes the director made while designing are listed in one quiet line.

items.title: How long it will take
items.text: Generate shows a time estimate before you start and a countdown while it works. It learns from your own runs.

items.title: Sources you can check
items.text: The ES articles behind the facts sit in one tidy Sources card, with dates.

items.title: Better briefs from trends
items.text: Picking a trend, a Try card or a Recent brief fills a real brief: who, what happened, the related headlines and why fans care.

items.title: AI usage explained
items.text: Open the AI usage card for your spend by tool, the team's week, what counts, when it resets and what free mode means.

entries.title: Sign-in and Dashboard: tidier screens, a cleaner error log

items.title: Errors shows real problems
items.text: Ordinary sign-outs, offline moments, "not set up yet" answers and the browser's resize notices no longer count as errors. Sign-in trouble is grouped and marked Sign-in.

items.title: People lines up
items.text: Role, last seen and status sit in the same columns on every row, and the list keeps the panel's margins.

items.title: Sign-in screens
items.text: No doubled sign-in link after a wrong password, full email hints on phones, and no box drawn around the sign-in help panel.

entries.title: Editor: tidier toolbar and panels on laptops and phones

items.title: The canvas toolbar fits
items.text: On smaller laptops the zoom, slide and image buttons stay inside the toolbar under the canvas, and it sits centred under your design.

items.title: Layers floats on smaller laptops
items.text: Below 1280px, opening Layers slides the list over the canvas instead of squeezing the design to a sliver.

items.title: Phone panels
items.text: A tab with nothing to change for a template now says so, and dark mode no longer shows white cards behind light text.

entries.title: Home, Settings and guides: small fixes on every screen size

items.title: Settings shows your real AI limit
items.text: The AI usage card in Settings now shows the same weekly limit as the sidebar card.

items.title: Tidier Home on phones
items.text: The banner no longer leaves an empty band above its button, and tool and post names show in full instead of being cut off.

items.title: Easier to read
items.text: Settings rows share one title style, selected filter counts are easier to read, and How FrameUp works keeps its title on one line on laptops.

entries.title: Editor: a cleaner settings panel that follows your selection

items.title: Settings follow your selection
items.text: Pick a layer in Layers or on the canvas and the panel opens its settings and marks them Selected. With nothing picked, the top line says you are editing the whole design.

items.title: One look for every control
items.text: Clear section titles with icons, the same field, toggle and switcher styles as Generate and Video Ads, and Export always pinned at the top. Collapse or expand every section in one click.

items.title: Make it wider, or drag a number
items.text: Drag the panel's left edge to resize it (it remembers). Drag the X, Y or Zoom label on a photo to change the number; hold Shift for bigger steps.

entries.title: Video Ads: paste any video link, and a tidier Find a clip

items.title: Paste any video link
items.text: Video link now takes X, Bluesky, Reddit, Streamable, Vimeo, Google Drive and Dropbox links, and direct .mp4, .mov or .webm files. You see the source, the quality (1080p, 720p…) and the size before it loads.

items.title: Clear answers when a site says no
items.text: YouTube, Instagram and TikTok don’t allow downloads, and some sites block them. FrameUp now says so and gives you the file to open and save, then drop it here.

items.title: Clip cards line up
items.text: Even spacing across Find a clip, and Use clip sits at the bottom of every card, so the buttons in a row line up.

entries.title: A cleaner account menu, Settings and Edit profile

items.title: New account menu
items.text: Your name, email and role at the top; Edit profile, Settings, Tours (with how many you've done), What's new and UI Library; Light, Dark or System appearance; Log out last. Works with the arrow keys and Esc.

items.title: System theme
items.text: Appearance can now follow your device's light or dark setting, in the menu or on Settings.

items.title: Edit profile keeps your changes
items.text: Role, team, note and photo now stay after you reload. Save shows what changed, checks the fields, and Ctrl/Cmd+S works.

items.title: Settings, regrouped
items.text: Appearance, Start page and your AI usage this week, all saving as you change them.

items.title: Tours panel and sign-out
items.text: Tours shows which ones you've finished. Logging out asks first only if editor work isn't saved, then shows a clear signed-out screen.

entries.title: Sign-in that doesn't loop, clearer emails, and a People view for admins

items.title: No more bouncing back to login
items.text: If this browser can't keep your login, FrameUp now says why and how to fix it instead of sending you back to the login page again. Fix sign-in clears only FrameUp's sign-in data; your designs and drafts stay.

items.title: Emails you can count on
items.text: Already have an account? We tell you straight away. Resend buttons show a countdown, expired links let you ask for a new one on the spot, and you can sign in with an emailed link instead of a password.

items.title: People and roles (admins)
items.text: Dashboard → People: search everyone, filter by status, approve access requests, change roles with a confirm step, and confirm a stuck account's email.

entries.title: Video Ads: pick several teams or colours at once

items.title: Several teams in one search
items.text: In Find a clip, By team now lets you pick up to 6 teams. You get clips of any of them in one list, one card per play, and each card marks the team it matched. Your picks are remembered for each sport.

items.title: Several colours too
items.text: By colour works the same way: pick up to 6 team colours and see clips of every team that wears any of them.

items.title: Multi-select filters
items.text: The Team and Colour filters in By moment and the clip library are now menus with checkboxes, so you can show two or three teams side by side.

entries.title: Generate: 17 new ES design looks in 7 tones

items.title: Looks from the ES board
items.text: Generate now designs like the ES social team: stat posts with the player cut out over the number, covers with stepped highlight boxes, quote posts and quote cards, ranked tables, headshot grids, bar graphs, post cards, stat sheets and more.

items.title: More than one mood
items.text: Each design picks a tone: light, paper, vivid team colour, dark, duotone, black-and-white editorial or ES blue. Every text colour is checked so it stays readable.

items.title: Better cut-outs
items.text: Cut-outs get a soft shadow, a rim light in the team colour and a blurred copy of their own photo behind them. Some designs let the player step out of the photo frame.

entries.title: Generate: real player photos and cut-outs in every design

items.title: The right player, sharp
items.text: Creative designs now use several ES photos of the people and teams in your brief, ranked for the right person, sharpness and a visible face. Logos, collages and photos of other people are left out.

items.title: Automatic cut-outs
items.text: The star of the story is cut out automatically for stat and cover designs. A cut-out is made once and reused for free after that.

items.title: Headshots and logos
items.text: Grids get a headshot for each named player, and designs get the team and league logos from the logo library.

entries.title: Free mode: FrameUp keeps working when the week's AI budget is used

items.title: Weekly AI budgets
items.text: Each person has $20 of AI a week and the team $45. Your sidebar card shows how much you have used and when it resets (Monday).

items.title: Free mode instead of errors
items.text: Over a budget, every tool keeps working without AI: Generate makes ES template designs, Video Ads writes copy from templates and finds clips in the library, Reels builds the plan from your brief, and Trends shows quick headline ideas. A short note at the top says so.

entries.title: Generate: stat lines, records, carousels and no blank photos

items.title: Player Stat Line and Team Record
items.text: Generate now makes both new templates: a full game line (3–7 numbers) and a record or final score under the team badge. Numbers stay with their own labels.

items.title: Never a blank photo
items.text: No ES photo? The design uses the team graphic, and the photo panel can search ES photos by name or team.

items.title: Same idea, new template
items.text: Refine on any design now remakes the same idea in another template that fits your brief.

items.title: Carousels
items.text: Open every design as one carousel in the editor, or download them all as a numbered ZIP.

items.title: Faster by keyboard
items.text: Press / to write a brief, 1–4 to pick directions and Ctrl or ⌘ + Enter to make them. A live trend makes posts in one click.

entries.title: Trends: what to post now

items.title: Post now
items.text: Trends opens on the top stories across sports, one per storyline, with Hot and Rising badges and why each matters now.

items.title: Storylines
items.text: Seven outlets on the same story are now one card, with the rest folded under it.

items.title: Post kit
items.text: One click: 3 headlines, the best template, a photo search, a reel hook and the video ad moment, with Make a reel, Video ad and Copy kit.

items.title: Your newsletter, your way
items.text: Pick The Huddle, Essentially CFB or ES Dugout, switch to a compact list, and use the keyboard (press ? for shortcuts). Saved is now a Shortlist you can copy for the team.

entries.title: Editor: save status, smarter templates, brand check

items.title: Always know it's saved
items.text: A small status next to Undo shows Saved, Saving…, Synced or Offline. Click it for your drafts. Ctrl/⌘+S saves now.

items.title: Best for this story
items.text: Press T (or Browse) for templates. FrameUp reads your headline, or a story pasted into search, and suggests the templates that fit. Recent templates sit on top.

items.title: Brand check before export
items.text: Export now flags hashtags, links, emojis, hype words, Cover lines too long to read, or a missing ES font. Export anyway stays one click.

items.title: Pills stay on the canvas
items.text: Long staggered Cover lines no longer run off the right edge; each pill now stays inside the 50px safe area.

entries.title: Today on Home, Gallery filters, request next steps

items.title: Today on Home
items.text: Your open requests, drafts on your account, the newest team exports and live trends, plus one-click Generate, Video Ads and Reels Studio.

items.title: Find any post
items.text: Gallery search matches every word, filters by person and posted or not, and the link keeps your filters. Press / to search.

items.title: Make another like this
items.text: Open a Gallery post and start a new one in Generate with its template and team filled in. Nothing runs until you press Generate.

items.title: Next step on every request
items.text: My requests shows the one thing that moves each request forward: assign, start, attach, send for review or mark done. Your move is flagged in the list.

items.title: Needs attention (admins)
items.text: The Dashboard opens with what to act on: overdue or unassigned requests, people waiting for access, bug reports and error spikes.

entries.title: Video Ads: today's ad set in one go

items.title: Make my daily set
items.text: Pick a newsletter and press Make my daily set: one Ask AI call writes 3 angles, each in the style that fits, shown in 9:16, 4:5 and 1:1. Edit any angle, then export all of them in one pass.

items.title: Check before you export
items.text: A free, instant check for a clear free offer, 55+ readability, trust, fit and safe zones, each with a one-click fix. An AI score is there when you want one.

items.title: Feed, Story and Reels
items.text: Meta preview now shows all three placements, including how the feed crops a 9:16 and how Stories show a 4:5.

items.title: Remembers your newsletter
items.text: Video Ads opens on the newsletter you used last, with its style, sizes, tint and button. Stat Card and Quote Card are gone; the empty preview is plain black until you pick a background.

entries.title: Editor: a better Layers panel, safe zones, slide tools

items.title: Layers you can work with
items.text: Each layer shows what it is and what's in it. Click to select it on the canvas (Shift or ⌘ for more), double-click to rename, drag to reorder, or press ⌘[ / ⌘]. Hide and lock sit on every row. Drag the edge to resize. YouTube thumbnails have layers now too.

items.title: Format and safe zones
items.text: The bar above the canvas shows the template and size you're on; click it to switch. Safe zones mark YouTube's timestamp corner, the Instagram grid crop and the ES margin. Export warns if your headline sits under the timestamp.

items.title: See it small
items.text: On YouTube, Small size shows your thumbnail at search and Up next sizes, so you can check it still reads.

items.title: Carousel slide tools
items.text: The ⋯ next to the slide numbers duplicates a slide into the next empty one, moves it left or right, or clears it.

items.title: Newsletter: copy the right thing
items.text: Image assets say Copy image link (the URL for the newsletter's image block); widgets say Copy HTML. A line under the buttons says where to paste it.

entries.title: Generate: a Creative look that composes new designs

items.title: Creative look
items.text: Generate can now compose designs instead of filling a template: cut-out players over giant numbers, prize art, split screens, scoreboards, unit charts and more, in ES fonts and team colours.

items.title: An art director picks
items.text: Each idea is drawn 2–3 ways; the art director keeps the strongest, applies one fix and tells you why in a specific note.

items.title: One story per design
items.text: A brief with two stories gets designs for both, each with a different composition and photo. Numbers come only from your brief.

items.title: Tweak and download
items.text: Try another composition, swap the photo or edit the words on the card, then download PNG or JPEG at 1080 wide.

entries.title: Reels Studio: a cleaner Story step

items.title: Trends that scroll cleanly
items.text: The league filter stays pinned while compact story rows scroll beneath it. Arrow keys move through the stories.

items.title: Settings at a glance
items.text: Style, Voice, Clips and Format sit in one summary. Tap one to jump straight to it.

items.title: Clear progress
items.text: Make my reel shows each step as done, in progress or to do, in place of the trend list.

entries.title: Reels Studio: the real ES logo, the best clips, sharper styles

items.title: The real ES logo
items.text: Every reel carries the official ES mark top-right at its guideline size and clear space, and end cards use the official wordmark. A check stops export if the logo is missing or moved.

items.title: Best clip for each beat
items.text: Clips are ranked for each beat: who is on screen, how fresh, how sharp, official first. With AI on, a vision check looks at a few frames (about a cent a reel) and the best part of the clip is used.

items.title: Pro motion
items.text: Headlines rise in word by word, beats push, wipe or flip into each other, numbers count up, and a light grain and vignette finish every frame.

items.title: Clip sound is muted
items.text: Clips play muted under the voice and music. Turn on Original clip audio under Music to keep their sound, low and ducked under the voice.

entries.title: Generate: open any design and keep working on it

items.title: Open a design
items.text: Click any Creative design to open it big: the AI assistant, the art director's suggestions with Apply, layers and text, swap photo, and every version with undo and redo.

items.title: Pick how many
items.text: Choose 1, 2, 4, 6 or 8 designs next to Generate. The estimated cost of each choice is shown before you run.

items.title: What could be better
items.text: Each card's director note now opens to what works, what could be better (one click to apply) and the lesson for next time.

items.title: Trending, Recent and Try
items.text: Live trends with their league and freshness, your recent briefs with Run again, and example briefs as format cards.

items.title: Every size
items.text: Switch a design between 4:5, 9:16 and 1:1 in the open view; the layout follows and still passes the ES check.

entries.title: Trends: a cleaner, faster board

items.title: Compact stories
items.text: Each story is now one tidy card or row: the title (two lines at most), one line with Hot, source, age and sources, and the rest of the storyline behind a small "more" toggle.

items.title: The same actions, in the same place
items.text: Design post, then Post kit, Reel, Video ad, Shortlist and Read in fixed slots on every story, in cards and list. Hover for a tip; on smaller screens the rest sit under ⋯.

items.title: Headline ideas on request
items.text: No more empty idea boxes: press Headline ideas on a card and three AI headlines appear, ready to copy or design.

entries.title: Home is now mission control

items.title: Start here
items.text: Home opens on the top story right now with one click to a post, a reel or a video ad. The brief carries only the story, and nothing runs until you press Generate.

items.title: Trending, with full titles
items.text: Every trend shows its sport, heat and age, two full lines of headline and Post, Reel and Ad buttons. College basketball no longer shows up as College Football.

items.title: Continue where you left off
items.text: Your exported designs, account drafts and Reels Studio projects in one list, newest first. Each tool tile also shows what you were last doing in it.

items.title: Team this week
items.text: Team exports with who and when, posts per day, top formats, the most active people and your own count and streak, all from the Gallery.

entries.title: Reels Studio: start from a game, a clip or a career

items.title: Format gallery
items.text: All formats in one place: the four news formats, plus Game Swing, Moment Replay and Hall-of-Fame Archive. Formats whose data server is not live yet say Coming soon.

items.title: Game Swing
items.text: Pick a live or finished NFL, CFB or MLB game, sorted by the biggest win-probability swing. Tick the key plays; the score, clock and win probability come from the game data.

items.title: Moment Replay and Archive
items.text: Turn one clip into setup, play and reaction frames you can nudge, or a player's career into cited moments with every source listed. Both export a reel and a 1080×1350 carousel.

entries.title: Video Ads: more college football and MLB clips, from official sources only

items.title: Many more college football and MLB clips
items.text: Find a clip now also looks at ESPN's college football play clips and MLB.com highlights, and covers every Power Four team. College football looks back 7 days, so last weekend's games are always there.

items.title: MLB in the offseason
items.text: MLB shows recent highlights from the last 30 days, labelled. If no games were played in that time, you get the last games of the season, marked Last games.

items.title: Official sources only
items.text: Every clip comes from a team, league or network account or site, and each card says who posted it, like “@Yankees · team account” or “MLB.com · league site”. Fan accounts, Reddit and Bluesky no longer appear. A link you paste still works, marked Unverified source if it isn't official.

entries.title: The creative director, ES guidelines and Bring it on-brand

items.title: Directions first
items.text: Generate now shows the director's 2–4 named directions: angle, hook, template, why it works, past ES posts behind it and a confidence score.

items.title: Pick, edit and steer
items.text: Pick one or several, edit an angle or hook, More or Less like this, or Skip · Auto. Set the tone and audience once.

items.title: The director's note
items.text: Every design says what works and one fix you can apply in a click. Results are grouped by direction.

items.title: Bring it on-brand
items.text: Drop or paste any design, even a carousel from another AI tool. The director lists what breaks the ES guidelines and remakes it with ES templates.

items.title: On-brand, checked
items.text: Every generated design passes an ES guideline check (fonts, palette, logo, safe area, copy) and shows On-brand or the fixes it made.

entries.title: Reels Studio

items.title: Reels Studio
items.text: Turn a trend or a brief into a 20–45 second 9:16 reel. No game footage: ES photos, team logos and stat cards.

items.title: Four formats
items.text: Explained in 30s, Stat alert, Top-5 countdown and Quote reel. Auto picks the one that fits the story.

items.title: Every number has a source
items.text: The script only uses numbers from the trend, your brief or a capped fact check. Quality checks block anything unsourced.

items.title: Voice, captions and music
items.text: The ES house voice (when set up) or captions only, word-level captions, and licensed music ducked under the voice.

items.title: Rights and cost before export
items.text: See where every asset comes from and what the reel cost, then export MP4 in your browser.

entries.title: Two stat templates and a logo library

items.title: Player Stat Line
items.text: A player photo with the team logo, name, opponent and up to 7 stats. Labels take the team's colours.

items.title: Team Record / Score
items.text: A big record or score under a round team badge, with the ESSENTIALLYSPORTS wordmark.

items.title: Logo library
items.text: 800 team, club and league logos (NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, WNBA, college, soccer, F1, tours) with search, favourites and your own uploads, wherever a design takes a logo.

entries.title: Reels Studio: Make my reel, four ES styles, human voices and clips

items.title: Make my reel
items.text: Pick a story and press one button: script, voiceover, clips, captions and the build happen for you. Then tap any beat to change just that beat.

items.title: Four ES styles
items.text: ES Classic, the light ES Data Explainer, the ES Analytics Series dashboard and ES Countdown, with live thumbnails and a suggested style for your story.

items.title: The voiceover is on by default
items.text: A more human voice (ElevenLabs v4) and four voices to choose from, with samples. Edited lines are re-voiced automatically, and the MP4 always carries the voice.

items.title: Mostly clips, never an empty frame
items.text: About 80% of a reel is video: official team and league clips from X. The rest are ES photos, team graphics or AI scenes with no people in them.

items.title: Data beats
items.text: Stat heroes, comparison bars, versus cards, dot rankings, 1-in-5 squares, step trackers, team tiles and position cards. Every number must come from a source.

entries.title: Video Ads v2, Trends hub, Ask AI and tours

items.title: Video Ads in three steps
items.text: Copy, Clip, Export. Research and rating are gone; the copy comes first.

items.title: Ask AI
items.text: Write 3 options, check grammar with instant fixes, shorten or punch it up. ⌘J.

items.title: Clips by team, colour, moment or link
items.text: With team logos, and only fresh clips from the last 5 days. Trends shows league logos too.

items.title: Frame and tint the clip
items.text: Fill or fit, zoom and drag the clip, then tint it black, navy, brand, team or ES blue. The export matches the preview.

items.title: Trends, fresher and one click from making
items.text: Only stories from the last 48 hours, duplicates merged. Each card can start a post, a video ad, or be saved for later.

items.title: Generate format cards
items.text: Real thumbnails, Auto by default, and it spots who, quotes and stats as you type.

items.title: Your AI usage
items.text: The sidebar shows your AI spend this week, out of $20. It resets every Monday.

items.title: Calmer focus and a live UI Library
items.text: One quiet focus style everywhere. The UI Library (profile menu) shows the whole design system, live.

items.title: Tours
items.text: Replay a tour any time from Tours in your profile menu, or the ? on a tool.

entries.title: AI Studio

items.title: AI Studio
items.text: Generate, Trends and Video Ads now live together under AI Studio in the sidebar, with their own look. Switch between them at the top of the page.

items.title: Trends inside Generate
items.text: Trend Design is now the Trends view of Generate. Pick a headline idea or "Design this" and Generate starts on it right away, without leaving the page. Old Trend Design links still work.

entries.title: Trend Design

items.title: Trend Design
items.text: A new page in Create: what US sports fans are searching on Google and reading right now, sorted into Golf, Tennis, NFL, College Football, MLB and Others. It refreshes every 5 minutes. Each story comes with headline ideas; click one, or "Design this", to open Generate with it as your brief.

items.title: Cleaner pages
items.text: Design Request, Tool Feedback, Gallery, Generate and Reel Captions use the same clean fields, labels and cards as the editor.

items.title: Easier to read
items.text: Small grey text and dark mode colours were adjusted so every page meets accessibility contrast levels.

entries.title: Editor round 2

items.title: Content · Photos · Style
items.text: The right panel has three tabs: text in Content, photos and the ES Image Pool together in Photos, placement and colours in Style. Tabs with nothing in them hide.

items.title: Search finds templates and actions
items.text: Press ⌘K / Ctrl+K and type: jump to any template, reopen a recent design, or Export, Copy link, Upload a photo.

items.title: Jump back in
items.text: Home shows your last four designs; one click reopens them.

items.title: Clearer template names
items.text: Section Header (Left / Centred), Video FI (Play Button), Tag FI (Corner Label), Headline List (Big Numbers / Simple), Trivia.

items.title: One look for icons and controls
items.text: Every icon shares one style, and fields and buttons in the right panel line up at the same sizes.

items.title: Phone menu
items.text: On phones the menu now matches the sidebar.

entries.title: Editor basics

items.title: Your work is saved as you go
items.text: Refresh or close the tab and everything comes back: every slide, layout and newsletter asset, with photos. "Start fresh" clears it.

items.title: Reopen past designs
items.text: The clock button next to Undo lists your last 30 exports. In Gallery, "Open in editor" opens a copy of posts you exported on this browser.

items.title: Browse templates with previews
items.text: "Browse" next to Post Type and Newsletter Asset shows every template as a picture, with search.

items.title: Check before export
items.text: Export warns when sample photos, sample text or an empty headline are still in the design.

items.title: Spell check
items.text: Headlines, quotes and names are now spell checked. Numbers, stats and links are not.

items.title: Keyboard shortcuts
items.text: Ctrl/⌘ + E exports, Ctrl/⌘ + Shift + L copies the link. Press ? to see them all.

items.title: Newsletter brand colours
items.text: Infographic FIs use each newsletter's colours from the Newsletter Hub, on one light grey background.

entries.title: Golf infographic FIs

items.title: 7 golf infographic FIs
items.text: Player Season Stats, Weekend Winners, Tournament Fields, Defending Champion, Player Quote and two collages, in Newsletter.

entries.title: Social Media additions

items.title: Multiple Tweets
items.text: Up to three tweets on one Social post, over your photo.

items.title: Golf and Neutral colours
items.text: Golf is a Social sport with its own colour sets, plus a Neutral option.

items.title: Essentially W NCAA
items.text: New brand in Video FI, Trivia and the widgets.

entries.title: Newsletter widgets

items.title: Financial Ticker and Headline Lists
items.text: Three new HTML widgets for newsletters: Financial Ticker and two Headline Lists (big numbers or simple).
